verdict.rationale: Square's Terminal API is documented for driving in-person checkout flows from a backend (e.g., tip collection, custom receipts), backed by SDKs (Node.js), sandbox testing, and webhooks for event-driven integration, matching a server-driven POS terminal workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reports validating real-world Terminal API integration reliability and a full OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s).
